eval-bot: ALERT: nightly-eval detected 3 failing suites on model redwood-7b-int4-v2 (quantized). Severity: medium. No linked PR.

Priya (ML Eng): saw the alert, jumping in.
Sam (Infra): pinging infra logs, any OOMs or sched delays?
Marta (Eval): failing cohorts: summarization-long, legal-qna, multi-turn-instructions. A lot of outputs are short or contain fabricated citations.
Priya (ML Eng): can you paste a couple of example failures?
Marta (Eval): ```
input: "Summarize the following legal clause..."
output (int4-v2): "In summary: the clause says nothing. See Smith v. Jones, 1984."
expected: a 3-4 sentence summary without invented case refs.
```
Sam (Infra): no GPU OOMs in the window. Noting a couple of CPU worker restarts at 03:10 UTC but nothing obvious.
Lee (SRE): rolling back the quant bundle for the canary host group would be low-impact; want to confirm regression first.
Priya (ML Eng): can we repro locally on the quantized weights? Marta, which prompt seeds show this most?
Marta (Eval): 7/12 seeds for the long summary cohort produce 60-80 token truncation or hallucinated refs. The legal-qna cohort shows hallucination in 4/8.
Priya (ML Eng): triage plan: 1) reproduce on staging with the same seeds; 2) run float32 baseline on same prompts; 3) dump token-level logits and topk diffs.
Sam (Infra): creating staging job now: job/evl-1755009876-staging -> ETA ~12m
Priya (ML Eng): owners: Priya + Marta for triage, Sam for infra support, Lee for rollback decision. @here if severity becomes high, escalate to oncall.
Marta (Eval): also seeing a spike in prefix KV cache misses in traces — might be a serialization mismatch with the new kernel path.
Priya (ML Eng): if cache misses align with truncation timestamps, that points to a runtime path bug rather than quantization math.
Lee (SRE): noted. If rollback is needed, I can coordinate a quick canary revert and smoke test.
Marta (Eval): uploading sample prompts+outputs to the eval bucket: s3://redwood-evals/alerts/1755009876/snapshots (will include seeds & model hashes)
Priya (ML Eng): thanks — I'll start the float32 vs int4 diff and post token-level deltas.
Sam (Infra): staging job started, logs streaming: https://logs.internal/redwood/jobs/evl-1755009876
Priya (ML Eng): next update in ~20m or sooner if we repro.
Sam (Infra): :thumbsup:
eval-bot: NOTE: nightly-eval runs every 6h; when resolved, please tag the alert with "repro-verified" and mark owner.
